resolution.note: feat(slice): offer override after a review FAIL on an unchanged head (t-smk6dwt)

title: slice run handles a review FAIL on an unchanged head
body:
Outcome: after a first review FAIL on an unchanged head, `krn slice run` offers the lead's documented choices instead of dead-ending: a rerun with `--override --reason <text> --evidence <text>` records the override through `krn review --override` on the exact head and continues to deliver; a plain rerun on an unchanged head refuses with 65 naming both options (fix and commit, or override) before verify/push.
Evidence: PR #204 (t-4bc72d3) dogfood: prepass-only false-positive FAIL; rerun ran verify and push, then `krn review --prior-record` exited 64 "--prior-record must have a different head SHA" (.krn/runs/lead/review-pending/slice-review2.log); override had to be done by hand outside the journal.
Proof: an observer where review 1 FAILs and the head is unchanged: plain rerun exits 65 with no review call; rerun with --override calls `krn review ... --override` once and records its record in the journal.
